prompt.text: Use code 1 for a table, 2 for a bar graph, 3 for a pictogram, 4 for a line graph and 5 for a pie chart. Monthly electricity use over three years must reveal recurring peaks and long-term movement. For the reason code, use 1 if a pie chart cannot show data with units, 2 if a pie chart shows shares of one whole and hides the change from month to month, or 3 if a pie chart needs at least 50 values. Enter a two-digit number: the first digit is the code of the most suitable display and the second digit is the reason code.

content.text: Decide what the reader needs to see as the months go by.

The electricity readings run in month order across three years, and readers need to see patterns that repeat and grow. Choose the display that follows one quantity over a long run of time, then think about what a pie chart would fail to show.

A line graph follows the monthly readings in order, so repeated peaks and the long-term movement can be seen. A pie chart shows shares of one whole and hides the change from month to month, so the reason code is 2.
